name: Omarchy Snap to Agent
author: Peter Vinter
description: Send what is on your screen to your default AI agent, with the context it needs to help right away. Select a region or window, check the preview, and your agent opens in the right folder, ready to work. Works with every agent Omarchy supports, asks before it acts, and masks likely secrets first.

barWidget.description: Send a region or window to your default AI agent, with context and a preview first.
